x_failures: Lists the naval torpedo among Drebbel's secrets 'lost upon his death', but page 50 says it was one of the secrets that remained to Keiffer.
y_failures: Calls the bread oven 'self-regulating' and ties the page 52 register diagram to it, but pages 51–52 make the self-regulating register part of a separate 'philosopher's furnace'.
reason: X accurately quotes Monconys on both furnaces, including the thermostat-like furnace, which is the most notable thing he saw; its only slip is filing the torpedo under lost secrets. Y merges the two furnaces into one and leaves out the regulating-furnace passage entirely.
